name: 🚨Escape Jail For Brainrots!
desc:
Can you break brainrots out of jail? Don't anger the prison guards! 😡

1. Break into a jail ⛏️
1. Steal a Brainrot🤫
2. Escape the guard chasing you 😡
3. Bring them back to your base to earn money 💵

Your BRAINROTS earn cash OFFLINE! 💤🤑

📜 Leave feedback on the game! Let us know what you think.
